mapper.insert: insert into employee(emp_no, branch_code, position_code, name, phone, email, hire_date, status) values(#{empNo},#{branchCode},#{positionCode},#{name},#{phone},#{email},#{hireDate},#{status})
mapper.select: select emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, position_code as positionCode, name, phone, email, hire_date as hireDate, status from employee where emp_no=#{value}
select count(emp_no) as totalEmp from employee where branch_code=#{value}
select count(emp_no) as totalHqEmp from employee where branch_code=#{value} and position_code in ('POS_MGR', 'POS_SUP', 'POS_STF')
select count(emp_no) as ptmCnt from employee WHERE branch_code=#{value} and position_code='POS_PTM'

select e.emp_no as empNo, e.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, e.position_code as positionCode, e.name, e.phone, e.email, e.hire_date as hireDate, e.status, p.position_name as positionName from employee e left join branch b on e.branch_code = b.branch_code left join position p on e.position_code = p.position_code where e.branch_code = #{value}
select * FROM employee WHERE branch_code=#{branchCode} and phone = #{phone}
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET branch_code = #{branchCode}, position_code = #{positionCode}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, status = #{status} WHERE emp_no = #{empNo} and branch_code=#{branchCode}
mapper.select: select count(distinct emp_no) as todayEmp from branch_schedule where branch_code=#{value} and work_date=CURDATE()
